statements: Robotics / Automation matters because it is emerging with positive year-on-year movement and still building acceleration.

Recent curated coverage connected the theme to robotics-automation, which helps explain why it remains worth tracking beyond the raw article count.

Robotics / Automation is also reinforced by 8 OpenAlex-linked research works, including 5 from the last three publication years, which suggests the theme has live research momentum and not just media attention.
The research lane clusters around Humanoid robot, Business, Robot, which sharpens the evidence base behind the theme beyond general news coverage.
